title: I Have a Super USB Drive
author: Darkness Black Bear / 黑暗狗熊
platform: Webnovel licensed English edition; original platform not verified by accessed metadata
summary: A biology student finds a USB drive with hidden operating rules and studies it to pursue wealth, longevity and power. Indexed reader reviews describe exporting items from films, turning fictional technology into experimental inputs. The useful lead is selective extraction through one physical carrier, with eligibility rules still needing direct reading.
verified_hook: Official indexed synopsis confirms a physical USB drive with discoverable rules and an immortality goal. Film-item extraction is corroborated only by indexed reviews.
unknowns: Exact extraction whitelist, charging cost and whether entries become real worlds.
Original publishing platform is not established by the accessed index.
proposal: Proposal: give a power-export device explicit eligible source objects, tests and a real carrier.
review_only_lead: NovelUpdates reviews by Alex Woods (2021-04-06) and Goth667 (2021-09-05) describe film-item extraction; do not treat their later-world claims as canon.

title: My Cell Prison
author: Yellow Shirt Fatty / 穿黄衣的阿肥
summary: The protagonist is reborn as a cell and uses a prison-linked power in a world of awakened ancient beings. Official metadata names several human growth disciplines. Indexed reviews add a portable prison and replaceable body parts, suggesting that anatomy can become a loadout while identity persists outside one fixed body.
verified_hook: Indexed publisher synopsis confirms cell rebirth and prison-code power. Portable storage and replaceable anatomy remain review-only leads.
unknowns: Limits on body-part selection, organism storage and disguise.
Which memories, skills and liabilities follow an acquired part.
proposal: Proposal: separate consciousness, cell core, replaceable anatomy and prison custody.
review_only_lead: Webnovel review by Usagi_mofu reports portable prison storage, face changes and body-part replacement; catalog chapter 5 is titled Portable Prison.

title: Let Me Game in Peace
author: Twelve-Winged Dark Seraphim / 十二翼黑暗炽天使
summary: Real dimensional zones become dungeon instances on a phone. One drop of blood buys another game life, while defeated creatures yield crystals, skills and companion beasts. This separates bodily danger from repeated simulated attempts, but still makes repetition consume something in the real body instead of offering an unlimited reset button.
verified_hook: Indexed novel description explicitly states blood-funded game lives, phone dungeon copies and transferable monster rewards. Official comic synopsis supports the blood/phone premise.
unknowns: Blood recovery and retry limits.
What information or loot cannot leave the phone and how faithfully the copy matches reality.
proposal: Proposal: let a safe rehearsal spend a real bodily resource and export only named reward types.

title: Losing Money to Be a Tycoon
author: Inebriation-seeking Blue Shirt / 青衫取醉
summary: A system rewards a businessman for losing money, so apparently bad projects become his intended progression route. Employees read those choices as brilliant leadership and accidentally make them profitable. Reviews describe separate company and personal funds, making bookkeeping categories and other people's independent actions central to exploiting the reward rule.
verified_hook: Official indexed synopsis confirms the loss-reward system and failed attempts to make unsuccessful games. Separate ledgers and conversion details are review-only in this scout.
unknowns: Settlement periods, conversion rates and prohibited spending.
Which losses count and who judges deliberate waste.
proposal: Proposal: use a reward system whose accounting objective conflicts with the helpers' own goals.
review_only_lead: NovelUpdates reviews by fireutsie (2021-01-02) and Macho (2020-10-02) describe separate funds and conversion rules; numerical examples are not accepted as canonical.

unknowns: Vessel autonomy when not controlled.

proposal: Proposal: give each projected life a local body and identity while tracking a separate traveling self.

summary: A man receives a system but loses control of his body to it. Instead of pressing upgrade buttons himself, he must live with an autonomous operator that acts through his physical form. The system and person can have separate motives and strengths, making advice, access and delegated control the real power interface.

unknowns: How body access is negotiated or restored.
Whether moral rules bind the operator, the owner or both.
proposal: Proposal: distinguish owning a body from controlling its actions and advising its operator.

title: Soul of Negary
author: Xu Ming / 虚鸣
summary: The starting protagonist is tricked into travel and stripped of his protagonist aura, leaving a remnant soul. The metadata reverses the usual benevolent-system premise: even narrative advantage can be harvested. Reader reviews suggest growth by absorbing souls and remaking identity, so the research target is what remains continuous as the original self erodes.
verified_hook: Indexed synopsis confirms a deceived traveler, stolen protagonist aura and remnant soul. Soul absorption and changing identity are review-only leads.
unknowns: What aura actually does and how it can be transferred.
Soul compatibility, identity loss and how distributed manifestations are controlled.
proposal: Proposal: allow a stolen narrative advantage to leave a surviving but changed power carrier.
review_only_lead: NovelUpdates review by Mors86 (2020-10-12) describes soul consumption and loss of the old human identity; later metaphysical claims remain unverified.

title: My Divine Diary
author: Dali Bao / 大力宝
summary: An accident grants infinite reincarnation, yet the protagonist repeatedly dies before reaching adulthood. Continuity alone does not supply a safe childhood, a useful body or social protection. The metadata frames godhood as the result of knowledge collected across many failed lives, turning survival of the next developmental stage into a meaningful progression gate.
verified_hook: Indexed synopsis confirms infinite reincarnation, repeated childhood death and knowledge accumulation toward divinity.
unknowns: Whether death ages are a hard rule or a starting pattern.
Memory storage, rebirth targeting and research methods that survive changes of world.
proposal: Proposal: make repeated life retain knowledge while still requiring protection through a vulnerable new body.

title: Fantasy Simulator

unknowns: Entry price, reward selection and whether simulated worlds are independent realities.
Which memories, ranks or bodies are retained and how rewards are judged.
proposal: Proposal: show a simulation's entry terms and named transferable results before it begins.

Successful trades extend its owner's own life, so one person's paid price feeds another person's longevity. The central hook is a broker operating a power market where ownership, valuation and personal attachment matter more than a common combat resource.

unknowns: Who sets fair prices, what can be sold and whether consent can be revoked.

proposal: Proposal: track what a customer relinquishes separately from what the broker gains, with explicit ownership and consent.

title: Information Omniscient (working English gloss)

A publisher-hosted reader note distinguishes perceiving vast data from understanding it, suggesting knowledge and filtering can matter more than adding another sensor or raising a damage stat.

unknowns: How literal the synopsis's all-information claim is.
Concept-learning requirements, overload, filtering, range and future-information limits.
proposal: Proposal: keep raw sensed information separate from what the observer has concepts to interpret.
